Lessons.Name: Single Stroke Roll
Lessons.Description: Alternate hands, every stroke the same height and volume. Start slow enough that it is even, then add ten BPM at a time.

Lessons.Name: Double Stroke Roll
Lessons.Description: Two strokes a hand. Let the stick bounce for the second one, and make it as loud as the first.

Lessons.Name: Single Paradiddle
Lessons.Description: Right left right right, left right left left. Accent the first stroke of each group and keep the others low.

Lessons.Name: Double Paradiddle
Lessons.Description: A paradiddle with two more singles in front, in groups of six: count it as triplets.

Lessons.Name: Paradiddle-diddle
Lessons.Description: Right left right right left left. It never swaps hands, so practise it leading with the left as well.

Lessons.Name: Five Stroke Roll
Lessons.Description: Two doubles and an accent, then the same from the other hand.

Lessons.Name: Single Stroke Triplets
Lessons.Description: Three even strokes a beat. The hand that starts each beat alternates, so accent the first of every three.

Lessons.Name: Flams
Lessons.Description: A quiet grace note just before the main stroke, from the other hand. One low stick, one high; they should sound like one fat note, not two.

Lessons.Name: Flam Tap
Lessons.Description: A flam and a tap from the same hand, then the other side.

Lessons.Name: Basic Rock Beat
Lessons.Description: Eighth notes on the hi-hat, kick on one and three, snare on two and four. The beat under half the songs in the library.

Lessons.Name: Rock Beat, Busier Kick
Lessons.Description: The same hands with an extra kick on the and of three. Keep the hi-hat steady while the foot moves.

Lessons.Name: Four on the Floor
Lessons.Description: Kick on every beat, snare on two and four, hi-hat open on the off-beats. Disco, dance and a lot of rock choruses.

Lessons.Name: Sixteenth Note Hi-hat
Lessons.Description: Sixteenths on the hi-hat with alternating hands; the right hand comes across for the snare on two and four.

Lessons.Name: Ghost Note Groove
Lessons.Description: A rock beat with quiet snare taps between the backbeats. The ghosts should be felt more than heard.

Lessons.Name: Shuffle
Lessons.Description: Triplets with the middle one left out: the long-short lilt of blues and swing. Snare on two and four.

Lessons.Name: Round the Kit Fill
Lessons.Description: Three bars of a rock beat, then a bar of sixteenths down the drums: snare, high tom, mid tom, floor tom. Land the crash on one.
